_note: What the firm buys (PRD E0-S1). A rule file, not prospect data. Every [CONFIRM] value must be filled by a principal; until then `outbound score run` refuses (or, with --draft-buybox, marks its output PROVISIONAL). Sectors default to the three the website covers; whether short-term rental portfolios are in is an open question (PRD Q1). The asset cap matches the direct-sale route in the plan (banks under about $10 billion; FDIC ASSET is in thousands). The scoring run records a hash of this file. Filled by a principal on 2026-11-17: non-performing, sub-performing and foreclosed (REO/OREO) loans, first lien only, $1M to $25M; short-term rental portfolios are in, as hospitality (Q1); no exclusions beyond these rules.

statusStages._note: D-P3, decided by a principal on 2026-11-17 (docs/paper-estimate.md section 9): the Call Report stages that count as each status. Stage ids: pastDue30to89, pastDue90 (90+ days past due, still accruing), nonaccrual, oreo (foreclosed property the bank owns, by property type; property, not loans). Current loans are performing, which this buy box does not buy. Modifications and lien position are not in the Call Report's stages, so neither decides a status. validateBuybox checks that every status above is mapped and every stage id is known.
